definitions.gloss: early period, initial stage, beginning phase
definitions.explanation: The first or early phase of a process, era, illness, or development. Emphasizes the stage rather than the exact starting point.

examples.japanese: {初期|しょき}{設定|せってい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{初期|しょき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: The illness was discovered at an early stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{初期|しょき}{段階|だんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: In the initial stages of the project, estimating the budget was difficult.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first, beginning) + {期|き} (period, stage). Used across many fields including medicine, technology, history, and project management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初期|しょき}{段階|だんかい} (initial stage)
- {初期|しょき}{設定|せってい} (default settings, initial configuration)
- {初期|しょき}{症状|しょうじょう} (early symptoms)
- {初期|しょき}{費用|ひよう} (initial cost, startup cost)
- {初期|しょき}⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧ (initial defect)
- {初期|しょき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ} (in the early days)
- ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧{初期|しょき} (early Edo period)

USAGE:
In technology, {初期|しょき}{設定|せってい} (default/factory settings) and {初期|しょき}{化|か} (initialization) are extremely common terms. In medicine, {初期|しょき} often refers to the early stage of a disease when treatment is most effective.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧: early — about acting or finding something early (⟦{早期|そうき}{発見|はっけん}→早期発見：16127_soukihakken⟧, ⟦{早期|そうき}{退職|たいしょく}→早期退職：08070_soukitaishoku⟧); {初期|しょき} names the first stage itself ({初期|しょき}{症状|しょうじょう})
